chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: The trio at Morton's Cafeteria and Lu's beer
summary: Lu and Danny worked a trio with Louis Metcalf at a cafeteria on 57th Street, where Lu, then 218 pounds, defied Danny's no-beer rule.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: We were talking about the other day, when we worked down at Morton's Cafe.

You remember Morton's Cafe? 57th Street between Columbus Avenue and Seventh Avenue...Seventh and Eighth.... Right by Central Park. There's Morton's Cafeteria there. 57th Street between Seventh and Eighth. Right off the corner. Now there's a bank there.
Well, between Seventh and Eighth, you've got Broadway.
Yeah, between them two. Between them two. Between Broadway and Eighth.
Oh. Well, that's a short block.
The cafeteria had a circular in there, and we worked in there.
Uh-huh. That's a short block, yes.
Danny used to tell me... I used to like to drink beer. "See, singers, these people they don't be drinkin' no beer, because you'll be belching all over the people." Now, I weighed 218 pounds.

Now, you was on this...you had this radio show with this guy telling you, "Lose weight," and everybody's trying to be streamlined, and... She was fat, see, and you see, with a singer it was a comic thing almost; you know, if you're fat, they're going to ridicule you. I'm trying to get her to reduce, for her to get streamlined. She had the face and the legs...

Yeah. So he said, "Don't drink no beer." So by the third night... We're right in the middle of the bar, see, and they've got all this draft beer, see. So I looked at... And they gave me a Coca-Cola, see. So I looked at...I told the man, and he said, "Well, what do you want?" Because you could get all you want for nothing. So I said, "Give me a beer." So Danny looked at me, and I said, "I'm sorry, but I ain't goin' for that." So Louis Metcalf was working with us...
The trumpet player, right. And he laughed! And we could get all we wanted to eat... And Koko(?), he was playing the bass...
